dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing observed from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Continuous smooth lateral margins along the visible boundary between the skin and the water surface, with no localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median intensity, characterized by a distinct longitudinal luminance gradient between the left and right halves of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the darker-shaded pixels on the left flank and the lighter pixels on the right dorsal plane.
